## 0.68.0 - bag arrows, the worth-wearing nudge, and a sharper model

At a glance: items in your bags that upgrade your current goal get a small
arrow - judged by the same honest net-swap verdict as the tooltip, spec-aware
(a Protection build marks tank upgrades), never on items above your level.
When a NEW upgrade reaches your bags, one chat line says so (Foresight never
equips anything for you). Too-high items keep their full verdict plus
"wearable at level N".

The model got sharper too: "Restores X per 5 sec" now counts (Survivability /
Mana sustain), per-school item damage (frost/shadow/fire/arcane/holy) is fixed
on the live client's key shapes, +Defense folds into avoidance, +Crit% folds
into crit - and tank verdicts with an armor-vs-health tension now explain
themselves ("the health side is +58 effective HP, the armor side -25").
Toggles: bagArrows, wearNudge.

Ship gate: Forever 331 checks, Classic 285. Display-and-advice only, official APIs only.
